content.text:
Supply Chain Analyst with 4 years of experience in inventory analysis, demand planning
support, procurement coordination, and operational reporting within consumer goods and
distribution businesses. Experienced in using Excel, Power BI, SQL, and ERP data to
monitor inventory levels, identify stock risks, analyze supplier performance, and support
monthly planning activities. Comfortable working with procurement, warehouse, sales,
finance, and logistics teams.

bullets:
Analyze inventory levels, sales history, purchase orders, and demand data for
approximately 1,200 active SKUs.

Prepare weekly inventory reports covering stock availability, slow-moving inventory,
stock-out risks, and excess stock.

Build and maintain Power BI dashboards for inventory and supplier performance
monitoring.

Support monthly demand and supply planning meetings by preparing historical sales
and inventory data.

Coordinate with procurement and warehouse teams regarding delayed purchase
orders and critical stock items.

Use Excel and SQL to clean, combine, and analyze operational data from ERP
exports.

Monitor supplier lead times and highlight significant delivery delays to procurement
teams.

Perform root-cause analysis on inventory discrepancies and recurring stock
availability issues.

Assist management with ad hoc analysis for promotions, product launches, and
inventory planning.

Monitored inventory movements across the company's central warehouse and
regional distribution locations.

Prepared replenishment recommendations using sales history, current stock,
outstanding orders, and minimum stock levels.
Maintained inventory planning spreadsheets and monthly KPI reports.

Coordinated with purchasing staff regarding replenishment orders and supplier
delivery schedules.
Investigated discrepancies between system inventory and warehouse reports.

Prepared reports on stock aging, inventory turnover, stock-outs, and excess
inventory.

Worked with warehouse teams during monthly cycle counts and annual physical
inventory checks.

Assisted procurement officers with purchase-order preparation and supplier quotation
comparisons.
Updated supplier information and purchasing records in Excel.
Followed up with suppliers regarding expected delivery dates.
Prepared basic purchasing and delivery-status reports.

Organized procurement documents including quotations, purchase orders, and
delivery records.

paragraphs:
Developed an internal Power BI dashboard using inventory and sales exports from the
company's ERP system. The dashboard tracked stock availability, inventory aging, inventory
turnover, and slow-moving products. Used Power Query for data transformation and created
calculated measures for monthly reporting.
